meta.fallbackTitle: ALFA Funeral Services — Sympathy and Delicacy
meta.description: ALFA funeral services: funerals arranged around the clock in Pleven, Levski and Sevlievo since 1994.

hero.title: We remember the datestogether with you.
hero.body: We arrange funerals around the clock. Afterwards we stay with the family for the memorial services, the obituaries and the care of the grave. Anyone who wants to put things in order ahead of time can record their wishes with us.

before.title: Plan ahead
before.text: We write down your wishes for the ceremony, the place and the obituary. You receive a copy, and your family knows what you wanted.

now.title: Help is needed
now.text: We come at any hour. We take care of the transfer, the cold room, the documents and the whole arrangement.

after.title: Memorials and the grave
after.text: Obituaries, wheat and keepsakes for memorial services, cleaning of the grave before the commemoration days. We remind you before every date.

monuments.title: Monuments in triplex, granite and marble

offices.title: Our offices
offices.pending: The office address, phone and opening hours will be added.

history.title: Our own offices, not a network of partners

planAhead.title: Put things in order early, without haste

calculator.title: Commemoration calendar
calculator.intro: Enter the date of death. We will work out the dates of the memorial services according to Orthodox custom.
calculator.errorFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
calculator.rule: The day of death counts as day one: the ninth day is 8 days after the date of death.
calculator.inDays: in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

footer.tagline: Sympathy and delicacy. Pleven, Levski and Sevlievo.
